plan.summary:
Health checks now give up on slow calls. The PR adds a cache check to the health run and adds a 2-second HTTP timeout to the probe.

- `run_checks()` now includes `check_cache()` with the db and queue checks.
- `probe(url)` now calls `httpx.get(url, timeout=2.0)` and returns the HTTP status with the URL.
plan.riskRationale: Small change in two files. The probe now makes a real network call. The excerpts show no handling for a timeout error, so a slow endpoint may raise an exception. No tests were seen.
plan.storyArc: The PR makes health checks stricter. First, the probe waits at most two seconds for a response and reports the status. Second, the health run adds a cache check beside the db and queue checks.

noise.reason: Import of check_cache only. Hunk-1 holds the runtime change that uses it.
Import of httpx only. Hunk-3 holds the runtime change that uses it.

topics.title: Probe times out after two seconds and reports status
topics.narrativeBrief: What does probe(url) do now? It makes an HTTP GET with a 2.0 second timeout and returns the status code in its JSON. Verify how httpx timeout errors reach callers, because the excerpt shows no handling.

topics.title: Health run includes the cache check
topics.narrativeBrief: What does run_checks() cover now? It adds check_cache() to the db and queue checks. Verify that check_cache is imported from service.checks and how callers use the list.
